text:
maya: FYI canary for cormorant-v2-q just returned an empty tools array for a funcall. app sees it as no-op and nothing gets invoked. repro below. :thinking_face:

maya: request: user asks bot to call weather tool for London
maya: model response (raw):
```json
{
  \"type\": \"tool_call\",
  \"tools\": []
}
```

liam: ugh, saw that too. can reproduce locally hitting canary endpoint with the same prompt. happens ~3/50 calls in my sample.

rachel: is this tied to sequence length or cutoff? any tokenization differences with quantized weights?

jorge: grabbing logs now. grep output:
```bash
$ grep \"tools\" /var/log/canary/cormorant-v2-q.log | tail -n 6
2026-03-22T14:22:10Z - INFO - resp: {\"type\":\"tool_call\",\"tools\": []}
2026-03-22T14:22:11Z - INFO - resp: {\"type\":\"tool_call\",\"tools\": [{\"name\":\"weather\",\"args\":{}}]}
2026-03-22T14:22:12Z - INFO - resp: {\"type\":\"tool_call\",\"tools\": []}
```

jorge: looks intermittent. attaching full sample in S3.

maya: telemetry shows spike in metric `toolcall.empty_tools.count` starting at 14:20 UTC.

liam: hypothesis: quantized model occasionally collapses the tool name output token sequence to an empty span, producing empty array. maybe EOS placement/streaming boundary bug with int8 kernels.

rachel: mitigation options:
- treat empty `tools` as invalid and trigger a soft-rescue retry (ask model to reemit)
- have router fallback to non-quantized variant for responses where `type==tool_call && tools.length==0`
- tighten validator to consider empty array a schema violation (fast fail)

maya: quick canary mitigation: router patch to fallback to cormorant-v2 (fp16) when tool array empty. I pushed a canary PR and started rollout to 10% now. :rocket:

jorge: test command to repro locally: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.redwood/api/invoke \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"cormorant-v2-q\",\"input\":\"Call weather tool for London\"}' | jq
```

liam: after forcing fallback I saw no empty-tools responses in 500 quick calls. looks promising.

rachel: long-term: add a lightweight schema rule for tool_call: require `tools` to be non-empty OR include a `reason` field explicitly when intentionally empty. also add eval coverage in our onboarding smoke tests to sample tool invocations under quantized kernels.

maya: +1 on both. I'll open a tracking issue with checklist: add schema rule, add canary telemetry alert, add onboarding smoke test, pair with runtime team to inspect kernel tokenization edge cases.

infra-bot: Rolling back to 0% for cormorant-v2-q canary and promoting fp16 fallback at router level. Will hold rollout for 30m and monitor `toolcall.empty_tools.count`.

liam: leaving a lightweight hotfix on router to soft-retry model with prompt: \"Please re-output the tool call as an object with at least one tool.\" if first response had empty array.

rachel: also add a debug flag to include the raw token stream in S3 for failing cases (redact user PII) so we can inspect token boundaries.

maya: creating the issue and adding folks. thanks team. :thumbsup:
